title: Retirement Planning with Borrowing Constraints and Income Support
abstract: arXiv:2611.33603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how pension income, its pledgeability, and government support that supplements effective consumption shape an irreversible retirement decision. In a continuous-time life-cycle model, a worker chooses consumption, risky investment, and the timing of retirement, subject to a tighter borrowing limit after retirement. When retirement reduces the utility value of a given level of effective consumption, immediate retirement can be optimal on a bounded wealth interval: a worker below the interval retires when wealth rises to its lower boundary, while a worker above it retires when wealth falls to its upper boundary. Two scalar boundary equations characterize these distinct entry points. Risky investment drops discretely upon retirement at either interior boundary, even when it rises with wealth along the low-wealth working branch. translated_title: 借贷约束与收入支持下的退休规划
translated_abstract: 我们研究养老金收入、其可质押性，以及补充有效消费的政府支持如何塑造不可逆的退休决策。在一个连续时间生命周期模型中，工人在退休后面临更严格借贷限制的约束下，选择消费、风险投资以及退休时点。当退休降低了给定水平有效消费的效用价值时，立即退休可能在一个有界财富区间上是最优的：低于该区间的工人会在财富上升至下边界时退休，而高于该区间的工人会在财富下降至上边界时退休。两个标量边界方程刻画了这些不同的退休进入点。在任一内部边界上退休时，风险投资会离散地下降，即使它在低财富工作分支上随财富增加而上升。在我们的双边界基准情形中，更大的收入支持会降低较低的退休门槛并提高……
tldr: 本文通过连续时间生命周期模型证明，当退休后借贷约束更紧且退休降低有效消费效用时，最优退休决策呈现双财富边界结构——低财富工人在财富升至下边界时退休、高财富工人在财富降至上边界时退休，且退休时风险投资离散下降，而政府收入支持会降低下退休门槛。
en_tdlr: This paper shows in a continuous-time life-cycle model that optimal retirement exhibits a two-boundary wealth structure—low-wealth workers retire when wealth rises to a lower boundary while high-wealth workers retire when wealth falls to an upper boundary—with risky investment dropping discretely at retirement, and greater government income support lowering the lower retirement threshold.
